parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
Language for returned information:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

parameters.name: CustomColumns
parameters.description: Custom field rules. Reference all fields using the @ symbol. Supported operators include `+、-、*、/`. Field names must start with a lowercase letter. For available fields, see the columns returned by the [Query SQL performance statistics](https://www.oceanbase.com/docs/community-ocp-cn-10000000001832433) API.

parameters.name: DynamicSql
parameters.description:
Indicates whether the SQL is dynamic. >
Specifies whether the provided SQL ID belongs to a dynamic SQL statement.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
End time for querying TOPSQL parameters. Use UTC time in the format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

This time supports only UTC in the format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

parameters.name: FilterCondition
parameters.description: Reference all fields using the @ symbol. For available fields, see the columns returned by the [Query SQL performance statistics](https://www.oceanbase.com/docs/community-ocp-cn-10000000001832433) API.

parameters.name: MergeDynamicSql
parameters.description:
Indicates whether to merge dynamic SQL statements in the response. >
Specifies whether to aggregate results for SQL statements containing IN clauses.

parameters.name: SqlTextLength
parameters.description: Maximum length of the returned SQL text.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: Start time for querying TOPSQL parameters. Use UTC time in the format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
